gloss: to hone one's skills; to improve one's abilities; to polish one's craft

definitions.gloss: to hone one's skills; to improve one's abilities; to polish one's craft
definitions.explanation: To work on improving one's skills or abilities through practice and effort. Implies dedicated, ongoing effort to become better at something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}して→練習する：22991_renshuusuru⟧{腕|うで}を{磨|みが}いて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I practice every day to hone my skills.

examples.japanese: ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もっと→もっと：00798_motto⟧⟦{磨|みが}きたい→磨く：02427_migaku⟧。
examples.english: I want to improve my cooking skills more.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{腕|うで}を{磨|みが}いてきた⟦シェフ→シェフ：05062_shefu⟧だ。
examples.english: He's a chef who honed his skills overseas.

notes:
IDIOM STRUCTURE:
⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧ (arm; skill) + ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ + ⟦{磨|みが}く→磨く：02427_migaku⟧ (to polish)

⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧ here means skill/ability. ⟦{磨|みが}く→磨く：02427_migaku⟧ (to polish) creates the metaphor of polishing or refining a skill like one would polish a gem or blade.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{腕|うで}を{磨|みが}く - to improve cooking skills
- ⟦{語学|ごがく}→語学：02770_gogaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{腕|うで}を{磨|みが}く - to improve language skills
- ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{腕|うで}を{磨|みが}く - to hone technical skills
- ⟦{日々|ひび}→日々：04804_hibi⟧{腕|うで}を{磨|みが}く - to polish skills day by day

USAGE:
Implies:
- Deliberate effort to improve
- Ongoing process, not one-time action
- Recognition that one can always get better
- Dedication and commitment to improvement

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{技|わざ}→技：02172_waza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{磨|みが}く→磨く：02427_migaku⟧ - to polish one's technique
- ⟦{実力|じつりょく}→実力：03277_jitsuryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧ - to build up ability
- ⟦スキルアップ→スキルアップ：08912_sukiruappu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to skill up (modern)
- ⟦{研鑽|けんさん}→研鑽：15484_kensan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{積|つ}む→積む：02294_tsumu⟧ - to accumulate training (formal)

RELATED WORDS:
⟦{腕|うで}を{振|ふ}るう→腕を振るう：07452_udewofuruu⟧ - to show one's skill (complementary - first you polish, then you show)
